evidence.quote: The overall workflow of the Metric Agent begins with simple data preprocessing, which includes noise removal and imputation of missing values.

practical_problems.note: noise removal and imputation are applied, but no experiment varies noise or missingness

summary: Automates detection, diagnosis and mitigation proposals for a distributed database with role-aware LLM agents; the preliminary Apache IoTDB fault-injection test reports precision/recall/F1 without baselines and checks mitigation text manually.
